sloka: प्रहृष्टो वा हते रामे जनस्थानम् प्रयास्यसि ।मयि वा निहते रामम् संयुगाय प्रयास्यसि ॥३-२७-५॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭo vā hate rāme janasthānam prayāsyasi ।mayi vā nihate rāmam saṁyugāya prayāsyasi ॥3-27-5॥

translations.english: If Rama is killed be happy and go to Janasthana or else if I am killed you can fight.
